command:
from airspace.storage import local_store,records,jobs,audit,organisations
from airspace.api import create_app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import select,func
s=local_store()
with TestClient(create_app(s)) as c:
 r=c.get('/api/v1/health');assert r.status_code==200 and r.json()['version']=='0.3.5-rc.1' and not r.json()['operational_acceptance']
 assert c.get('/api/v1/records/case').status_code==401
 with s.engine.connect() as conn:
  counts={t.name:conn.execute(select(func.count()).select_from(t)).scalar_one() for t in [records,jobs,audit,organisations]}
  assert not any(counts.values()),counts
s.engine.dispose()
print('Actual empty database, zero operational records and authenticated API boundary verified')
